start.title: Meet Sara, a young investigator!
start.sub: Watch her story. Then it is YOUR turn.
start.soundNote: Sound is on. Use the buttons at the top to change it.

lines.text: Hi! I am Pip the owl. Watch Sara solve a mystery, then it will be YOUR turn!
Hmm... do my classmates sleep enough?
Every investigation starts with a QUESTION. That is the Ask step!
I think they sleep about 8 hours.
Good plan! Scientists GUESS first, then check with data.
Hi! How many hours did you sleep last night?
Nine! ... Eight!
Ten! ... Only three... yawn!
Every answer is a piece of DATA. Now Sara can look for a pattern.
I will draw a graph, so I can SEE the answers.
Most kids sleep 8 or 9 hours. But one kid sleeps only 3!
Graphs help us see the answer. The tallest bar is what most kids said.
Now numbers! The centre number is 9 and the mean is 7.8.
Sara guessed 8 hours. That was very close!
Chance tells us how SURE we can be. Watch the die roll!
I think most kids sleep 8 to 9 hours. My proof: the centre number is 9.
I am quite sure. I say: LIKELY!
Hooray! Great thinking, Sara!
Now it is YOUR turn! You are the investigator.
You will study a pretend class, just like Sara. Try it again and again!
At the end you make your own Evidence Card. Ready for your mission?
